description: Defined public aggregate metrics for the INSTAR Lab Record Room. The registry describes a nonprofit research institute's resource and output position for donors, board members, and program officers; it is not a sponsor past-performance scoreboard. A data owner must approve a definition and provide a sourced observation before a value is published. A metric with no approved observation renders as Not reported. A measured zero is published only when an approver has attested it, and it renders as the number zero rather than as Not reported.

metrics.label: Grants awarded
metrics.description: The value of grant awards made to INSTAR Lab on or before the stated as-of date, reported by the type of funder that made the award.
metrics.grain: one funder type at one cumulative as-of date
metrics.population: Grant awards whose award instrument names INSTAR Lab Inc. as the recipient and whose award date falls on or before the as-of date, partitioned by funder type: federal, state, or private (private foundations and corporate funders).
metrics.exclusions: This is not proposals submitted, pledges, gifts, in-kind support, program service revenue, cash on hand, or an estimate of applications still under review. A funder type with no award is published as a measured zero; it is never omitted, because an omitted category is indistinguishable from an unmeasured one.

metrics.label: Contributions received
metrics.description: The value of charitable contributions received by INSTAR Lab on or before the stated as-of date.
metrics.grain: one institution-wide total at one cumulative as-of date, recorded under the reserved donor-type value all; per-donor-type reporting is a separate future grain and must not be added to the institution-wide row
metrics.population: Contributions of money or property received by INSTAR Lab Inc. and recorded as charitable contributions on or before the as-of date.
metrics.exclusions: This is not grant awards, pledges receivable, in-kind services, program service revenue, or an estimate. It is never reported as a nominal zero: a year with no approved figure is Not reported, not zero.

metrics.label: Annual revenue
metrics.description: Total revenue for one complete reporting year, reported by revenue source.
metrics.grain: one revenue source per complete, non-overlapping reporting year; the Record Room reports complete calendar years until an approved fiscal calendar is published, and the institution-wide total is recorded under the reserved source value all
metrics.population: All revenue recorded by INSTAR Lab Inc. in the reporting year, partitioned by source: contributions, grants, program service revenue, and other income.
metrics.exclusions: This is not grants awarded, contributions received, total assets, expenditure, or a filed tax return. It is not net income or an estimate, and it is not substituted by a bound: a year with only a bounded figure is Not reported.

metrics.label: Publications
metrics.description: The count of peer-reviewed publications authored by INSTAR Lab personnel on or before the stated as-of date, reported by publication type.
metrics.grain: one publication type at one cumulative as-of date
metrics.population: Distinct peer-reviewed publications that name an INSTAR Lab Inc. author and carry a publication date on or before the as-of date, partitioned by publication type: journal-article or conference-paper.
metrics.exclusions: This is not preprints, submitted manuscripts, accepted-but-unpublished work, blog posts, news briefs, datasets, or a citation count. The measure is published from zero because a count displayed at zero is a commitment, not an omission.

metrics.label: Completed research outputs
metrics.description: The count of research outputs completed in the reporting year, reported by output type.
metrics.grain: one output type per complete, non-overlapping reporting year; the Record Room reports complete calendar years until an approved fiscal calendar is published, and the year total is recorded under the reserved output-type value all
metrics.population: Distinct research outputs completed by INSTAR Lab Inc. during the reporting year, partitioned by output type.
metrics.exclusions: This is not active projects, publications, datasets, page views, downloads, citations, or outcomes. It is not zero by default: a year with no approved count is Not reported.

metrics.label: Datasets released
metrics.description: The count of datasets released for public use by INSTAR Lab on or before the stated as-of date.
metrics.grain: one release channel at one cumulative as-of date, recorded under the reserved channel value all for the institution-wide total
metrics.population: Distinct datasets published for public use with an INSTAR Lab Inc. release date on or before the as-of date, partitioned by release channel.
metrics.exclusions: This is not datasets under preparation, internal working data, code repositories, published tables inside an article, or a commitment to release. A published open-data route is a statement of intent, not a release count.

metrics.label: Technology transfers
metrics.description: The count of completed technology-transfer agreements involving INSTAR Lab on or before the stated as-of date.
metrics.grain: one transfer type at one cumulative as-of date, recorded under the reserved type value all for the institution-wide total
metrics.population: Distinct executed technology-transfer agreements that name INSTAR Lab Inc. as a party and carry an execution date on or before the as-of date, partitioned by transfer type.
metrics.exclusions: This is not conversations, proposals, memoranda of understanding, prospective partnerships, or an agreement under negotiation. A technology-transfer route on the public site is not evidence of an executed transfer.
